name: audit-fixture-nestjs-deep
_comment: Hoisted compatibility audit. Peer-heavy fixture: NestJS has the deepest peer-dep chain in mainstream backend Node. @nestjs/common, @nestjs/core, reflect-metadata, rxjs — all interconnected via peers. Decorator-based DI relies on metadata reflection working consistently across packages; a hoisting bug that gives different rxjs or reflect-metadata instances to different parts of the chain breaks DI silently.
